description: An elderly bearded man in a cream turban and long robe, with a red-and-gold sash, holds out a curved gilt-hilted sword toward a uniformed officer in a dark red tunic, peaked cap and cross-belts. They stand in a dusty courtyard before a red sandstone arched gateway with domes and white inlay. Turbaned horsemen on dark horses stand in the background and haze fills the air.
